summary: Retest targeting the autofill/light-box bug fix on the signup email inputs and nav search input, plus spot re-run of 3 named checks per briefing. Backend pytest suite (4 cases) re-run clean. New browser check email-search-input-no-light-box confirms: stylesheet has input:-webkit-autofill rules with -webkit-text-fill-color + long background-color transition; agent-one-signup-email-input (dark card) shows box-shadow none / transparent bg / light text rgb(245,242,236) on both click-focus and programmatic focus; tag-one-signup-email-input (light card) box-shadow none; search-input has aria-label 'Search hussh', box-shadow none, transparent bg, white text, and results still filter by query ('agent' returned matching rows). Visual screenshots confirm no white/light halo box behind any of these inputs and the search bar shows a gold underline instead. Re-ran email-signups-flow, wcag-aa-audit, nav-dropdowns by name -- all passed (wcag-aa-audit confirms axe wcag2a/aa/21aa clean at 1440/390 and visible focus ring on skip-link). 0 bugs found.

Screenshot confirms no visible halo/box around either pill.

Screenshot shows gold bottom border on the search row, no white box.

action_items.detail: Per instructions this retest only re-ran email-signups-flow, wcag-aa-audit and nav-dropdowns by name (not the full 26-check regression suite from iteration_5); those three plus the new autofill-box check all passed. Full regression suite from iteration_5 was not re-executed this pass -- recommend a full re-run if broader confidence is needed before next release.
